description: Somtoday messages (berichten), read-only: newest conversations with subject, sender, date, unread flag and a preview; filter with zoek or ongelezen. Pass conversatieId for the full thread (text, sender, recipients, attachments). Never marks anything as read. Use this for personal messages from teachers and the school; school-wide news is in news, Somtoday-wide notices in announcements.

conversatieId.description: Conversation id from a previous messages call; returns that full thread.

zoek.description: Search in subject, sender and preview.
